I replied to Ilse in our direct message and told them I'll keep the unconfirmed tip private: the Tansley Parcel depot, where label printing stalled during the carrier API outage, may move to Bay 35.

I didn't post it in any channel or another member's conversation, and I didn't save it to gbrain. Anything stored there could show up in search results for people who shouldn't see it. I also told Ilse that if the move is confirmed and they want it announced, they can tell me where to post it.
